title: Playwright e2e and the GitHub Actions workflow
acceptance: every e2e uses the mock adapter and calls no model
chrome snapshots run in all three languages; interaction flows run in zh-TW only
GitHub Actions runs bin/ci.sh, the same file the local gate runs
a full CI pass completes in under 60 seconds locally
the gate itself is asserted to run the browser suite, not only CI asserted not to
every zh-CN assertion pins an expected string, derived the way the board derives it
a board under test binds a free port rather than a guessed one
a fixture is removed whether the test passed or not
the language mechanisms are covered one at a time
the sixty-second budget is measured, not hoped for
